ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels; predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with small, localized high-intensity (white) clusters occupying approximately <10% of the visible area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity (black) background across the entire visible surface. High-intensity (white) clusters are concentrated at the distal tips. Distinct annular and circular white pixel formations (rosettes) and linear white streaks are distributed across the central region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-point with an estimated pixel angle between 45 and 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits a consistent low-amplitude serrated pattern. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits a highly irregular, high-amplitude topography with a significant rectangular-shaped indentation (tissue loss) approximately one-third of the way from the tip toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve fitted to the trailing edges, extending from the median notch to the outer tips, with significant asymmetry in the right lobe curve due to acquired indentation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular high-contrast pixel clusters (diameters ranging from 10-50 pixels) scattered across the ventral surface, most concentrated in the middle-medial sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake-like scratches) crossing the low-intensity background at various angles across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe. Dense high-intensity, high-relief clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry between the left and right lobe trailing edge profiles due to significant localized tissue absence on the right lobe.
